details: All feature engineering, scaling, target transforms & feature selection fitted strictly inside training folds.
Outer test fold was kept completely sacred across 25 outer test iterations.
Log1p applied only to non-negative targets; Cd strictly evaluated on RAW scale.
Cation/anion ratios calculated using meq/L conversions; Fe/Mn treated as secondary ratio with no pseudo-Eh.
Real data only (N=40). No GMM, CTGAN, SMOTE, or VAE used.
No deep neural networks, Transformers, or cross-attention introduced.
